accepted.name: biomarker_basic
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  id,
  gene_symbol,
  biomarker_description,
  biomarker_id,
  test_is_a_panel
FROM biomarker
accepted.description: Normalized projection of the biomarker table exposing core descriptive attributes and canonical keys. Use when questions need biomarker metadata, gene symbol, panel flag, or to join to alias/article/link tables. | Use for: list biomarkers and their gene symbols; count biomarkers flagged as panels vs single-gene; join biomarkers to aliases, articles, or FDA records

accepted.name: biomarker_fda_test_basic
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  test_trade_name,
  test_manufacturer,
  test_submission,
  biomarker_origin,
  doid,
  histological_type,
  specimen_type,
  platform_method,
  test_number_genes,
  test_adoption_evidence,
  test_approval_status,
  test_study_design,
  clinical_significance
FROM biomarker_fda_test
accepted.description: Canonical projection of FDA test records exposing trade name, submission id, manufacturer, disease id (doid), platform, specimen and approval status. Use when analyzing FDA test attributes or joining to FDA-drug/trial/link tables. | Use for: summarize FDA tests by manufacturer or approval status; filter tests by disease (doid) or specimen type; join tests to trials, drugs, or biomarker_fda master records

accepted.name: disease_basic
accepted.description: Projection of disease table exposing id and name. Use to resolve disease names from doid foreign keys and for joins to tests, mutations, and other disease-linked data. | Use for: resolve disease names for DOIDs; join disease metadata to tests or mutations

accepted.name: anatomical_entity_basic
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  id,
  name,
  description
FROM anatomical_entity
accepted.description: Projection of anatomical entities exposing id, name, and description. Use to describe tissues/organs referenced by uberon_anatomical_id across tables (biomarker_edrn, cancer_tissue, healthy_expression). | Use for: describe tissues referenced by uberon ids; join anatomical descriptions to expression or biomarker data

accepted.name: differential_expression_results
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  gene_symbol,
  doid,
  log2fc,
  pvalue,
  adjpvalue,
  statistical_significance,
  expression_change_direction,
  subjects_up,
  subjects_down,
  subjects_nochange,
  subjects_nocoverage,
  subjects_total
FROM differential_expression
accepted.description: Projection of differential expression results per gene_symbol and disease (doid), exposing effect size, p-values, direction and subject counts. Use for filtering significant genes, joining to gene or disease metadata, or aggregating counts of up/down genes. | Use for: list significantly differentially expressed genes for a disease; compute counts of up/down-regulated genes; join differential expression to disease names or gene metadata

accepted.name: disease_mutation_basic
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  id,
  chromosome_id,
  chromosome_pos,
  ref_nt,
  alt_nt,
  ensembl_transcript_id,
  cds_pos,
  peptide_pos,
  aa_pos_uniprotkb,
  ref_aa,
  alt_aa,
  mutation_freq,
  data_source,
  doid
FROM disease_mutation
accepted.description: Normalized projection of disease mutations exposing genomic coordinates, transcript/protein positions, alleles, frequency, source and linked disease (doid). Use when analyzing mutation counts, joining to articles/predictions, or mapping to proteins. | Use for: list mutations for a disease; join mutations to articles, impact predictions, or tissue annotations; map mutations to proteins/transcripts
